strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その最後となった一家には、一人の少年がおってな」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そんな暗い陰を思わせない程元気がよく、いつも四人の少女達と一緒に仲良く遊んでおった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「春には花を摘み、夏には川で泳ぎ、秋には木の実を集め、冬には雪で遊ぶ‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「時々、喧嘩をすることもあったが、兄妹‥‥いや、それ以上に仲が良かった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「子供達の親はそれを温かく見守っておったもんじゃ‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「だが‥‥‥そんな幸せも永くは続かなかった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「少年の母親が病で倒れ、そのまま帰らぬ人となってしまったんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それを嘆いた父親は、永いこと考えた末、自分の故《ﾌﾙ》郷《ｻﾄ》に‥‥即《-ｽｻﾞﾜ》ちこの世界へ帰ることにしたんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「少女達の親は何度も引き止めたのだが、父親は『妻の匂いが残るここにいるのは辛い』」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「『それに、妻も少年を人間世界の中で平凡に暮らさせたいと願っていた』」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そう言って、ついに首を縦に振らなかった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そこまで決心が固いのなら仕方がない‥‥と、幼なじみの親達は快《<ｺｺﾛﾖ》く、親子を見送ることにしたんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「この親子がその世界を出る前の晩、とんでも無い事が分かったのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「少女達が少年と別れたくない一心で、少年と婚約の儀式を取り交わし、その事を親に告げたのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「将来、少年が自分の旦那様になるのだから、親が少年を引き止めてくれる筈‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そう思い立っての行動じゃった‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「お陰で蜂の巣をつついた様な大騒ぎになった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それはそうじゃろう。その娘達の親は皆、『長《ｵｻ》』と呼ばれる複数の種族を統べる者」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「大げさに言えば、少年の幼なじみ達は皆『お姫さま』じゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「この婚約も子供の可愛い口約束‥‥そう思うかもしれんが、その世界では約束事は重いのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「一度約束したからには、まず、破ることは許されない程に」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「上に立つ者として、約束を破る事は言語道断と言えよう」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「こんな条件下で、もしこの世界で同じ事が起きたらどうなるか‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「想像？　う～ん‥‥‥想像と言っても何を例えて良いか‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「一人の男が、四つの国の姫とそれぞれ婚姻の約束を結んだらどうなる？」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そりゃぁ‥‥‥確かに大騒ぎだな」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その事を知らされた長の一人は、すぐに少年を呼び出し、事の真相を問うた」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その事を質問されると、少年は恥ずかしさで顔を真っ赤にし、慌てながら身に憶えが無いことを語った」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その様子を見ていたその長は、娘達の狂言だったかとホッと胸をなで下ろした‥‥‥が�ｬ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その後に少年が、そんな約束をした憶えはないが、」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「『神が宿る御神木の下で、少女達の『血』を舐めさせられた』‥‥‥と、溜息混じりに呟いたんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それを聞いて、その長《ｵｻ》は喉から心臓が飛び出る程驚いた」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「事もあろうに、少女達がやったのは約束事で一番重い誓い方だったんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「交わした本人達が死なない限り、必ず果たさねばならない約束をな」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その長は途方に暮れた。その少年が孫娘の婿になるのが嫌だったわけでは無い」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それどころか、自分の孫娘と本当の孫の様に可愛がっていた少年が、」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「将来夫《ﾒｵﾄ》婦になってくれればどれ程良いかと、いつも思っていたのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「じゃが、問題は約束を取り交わしたのが自分の孫だけではなく、他の長の娘達とも同じ約束をしたと言う事じゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「これは少年が大変危険な立場に立たされてしまった事を意味する。」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「何故なら、その少年を手中におさめれば少なくとも四つの里を手玉に取る事が出来る」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「権力を欲する者にとって、少年はこの上無い格好の獲物なのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「『このままでは少年の身が危ない』」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「『不幸か幸いか、少年は自分が何をしたのか理解していない。しかも、この事を知っているのは私だけだ』」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そう考えたその長は、少年の記憶を完全に消去し、二度と帰って来れないよう、何重もの呪いをかけた」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そして、少年の父親に事情を説明し、誰にも気付かれないようにそっと旅立たせたのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「二度と会え無くなるが、全てはこの子の為だ‥‥‥と、涙を忍んでな‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それから十数年の月日が流れ、娘達が美しく成長した頃、二度と帰って来ない筈の少年が、ひょっこりと帰ってきたんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そやつに掛けた呪いが解けたのか、それとも偶然が重なって呪いを無効にしたのか‥‥‥理由は分からん」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「さて、少年が帰ってきた事を知った娘達は、すぐに少年に会いに行った」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「しかし、少年は記憶を消されていた為、少女達が誰か分からず、その行動に困惑するばかり」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「何もかも忘れている少年に、娘達の落胆は激しかった‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「だが、それでもいつかは思い出してくれると信じ、少年を慕い続けた」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「一方、そんな事など何も知らない少年は、美しい娘達に一目で心を奪われたんじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「これで少年と娘達は相思相愛となったわけじゃな」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full
a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そして、流されるままに娘達に手を出してしまったのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その様子を、少年の記憶を消した長《ｵｻ》が見ておってな」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「『娘の純潔を奪ってしまったからには、私だけではどうする事も出来ない』」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そう考え、他の長達に今までの事を全て話し、相談を持ち掛けた」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「それからが大変じゃった。様々な意見が飛び交い論議が繰り返され‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その結果、少年は再度追放される事になった、記憶を消された上でな‥‥‥」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「本来なら『死』をもってその罪を償わせる所だが、他の長《ｵｻ》達も少年が息子のように可愛かった」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「その為、こんな比較的軽い罪ですんだのじゃ」
strings.note: a message: vertical (a line a column, the letters on their sides), 41 letters a line, 6 lines a window; broken between words, a new page after a click when the window is full

strings.jp: 「そして、少年は再び追放され、二度と戻ってくることは無かったということじゃ‥‥‥」
